## Change

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List commands or device scenarios actually run, results, and checks not run.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No real health records, private document names, credentials, or model binaries included.
- [ ] New fixtures use fictional data.
- [ ] Relevant localization and accessibility behavior remains intact.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices match the change.
- [ ] Any storage, backup, permission, signing, or licensing impact is described above.
